title: Anyone can add dust to a position and shorten its lock
rootCause: MlumStaking._requireOnlyOperatorOrOwnerOf passes msg.sender as both the owner and the spender it asks about, so the check always holds, and addToPosition recomputes the lock from what is left of it.

poc.observable: test_a_stranger_cannot_shorten_a_lock fails with "the lock stays as its owner set it: 604800 != 1209600"
